label: Counterfactual guidance and self-application against imitability exemplars (#2145 lane C round 3)
summary: See docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md, section 'Counterfactual guidance and self-application against imitability exemplars'. Follows attempt 421caba9 (round 2), which left the containment-recognition bridge d1fb6414 at parity with A4 (contained, individuating, value-ranked modes of imitability guiding favouring, not apprehended). A4 is defined as a structural duplicate of the personal source, so parity on structural tests follows from round 2's definitions and is not further evidence. Owner-approved tests, applied identically to both, in their strongest encoded forms. (1) Counterfactual guidance with graded respect weights: an outweighed reason guides when raising it alone (RaisesOnly, other respects and candidates fixed) makes the favouring follow it. Placed diagnostic 1587c760 (guidanceTable, tests d1fb6414): the good-tracking profile (shared) is guided; a fit-blind profile and a fixed favouring meet the outweighed condition and are not guided; a fit-only nature faces no outweighed fit reason; the second-order standard ranks the good-tracking over the fit-blind profile. Lean-only: respectBlindNotGuided, singleRespectTrackerNotGuided (a one-respect tracker is guided by no outweighed reason; the D-nature's form only when its end content is one respect of a graded value), guidanceOfTracking, guidanceLabelIndependent, fixedNotGuided, degreeOnlyRegistersNoRespectBetweenTies. Registration of outweighed respects was argued, not tested: degreeOnlyRegistersNoRespectBetweenTies shows only that an overall-degree-only representation cannot register a respect's strict ranking between overall ties (the antecedent will and a mode's own degree, read as overall degrees, fall under it); it does not show that registration needs per-respect stand-ins, since one individuating stand-in per candidate can carry several respect-indexed rankings, on both sides (an analyst extension of round 2's ranked modes and of q.15 a.2's many ideas alike); so registration is the same demand on both accounts and no discriminator. (2) Self-application: weak form (SelfApplies, own favouring over a determination d) reduces, when d is not had, to the criterion at second order (selfApplicationIndividuates); strong form (SelfAppliesToStandard, responsiveness to the second-order standard SecondOrderStandard): the standard is scenario-invariant, so no second-order profile depends on it (secondOrderStandardNotDependedOn), which does not make any profile Fixed; under the scenario-relative standard SecondOrderStandardAt both sides can show second-order dependence, including at a necessary source whose own favouring is good-tracking, since an alternative's agreement with value can vary (scenarioRelativeStandardDependedOn); no dependence follows only on a scenario space where value does not vary, which is not the good-general setting (invariantAlignmentNoSecondOrderDependence); parity at d1fb6414 follows from the structural duplicate. Horn A's rationale, if extended to second order, would misclassify necessary self-love using dependence as its non-restriction test, but not using restriction relative to value. Self-love available to both (q.19 a.3; for the rival an analyst posit, Plotinus Enn. VI.8.15 navigation only, with quasi-intellective language there); ranking possible alternatives to its own favouring unavailable to both at a necessary source; self-apprehension presupposes the dispute. Symmetry: same articulation demand (#1879), different proposed payments: a plurality in being understood (personal) versus a mind-independent, non-composing plurality ranked in several respects (A4, #1892). Rejected: the weak guidance test (passed by a respect-blind profile); 'further mark the D-nature fails' for Lane 2b's non-Fixed dNature; guidance or registration as evidence of mind; per-respect stand-ins as a requirement of registration and per-respect modes as a new commitment of A4; self-apprehension as discriminator; necessity of self-favouring against A4. Semantic challenge of ad289e982..8a36e93f0 (three P1, five P2) repaired on this branch after 8a36e93f0. Targeted re-check of 8a36e93f0..134e91c95: one residual P1 (fixed-orientation overstatement) and one P2 (one-sided horn-A sentence), fixed in the following commit. Final confirmation at 70d3e8d2b: one P1 (prose misreading of the invariant lemma as a contingent/necessary split), withdrawn and qualified in the following commit without new formal content; review closed at the repair cap. Codex P1 on PR #2178 (comment 4723059108): the inference from degreeOnlyRegistersNoRespectBetweenTies to per-respect stand-ins, and per-respect modes as a new commitment of A4, exceeded the lemma; restricted to overall-degree-only representations in prose, records and the Lean doc comment, with registration recorded as the same demand on both accounts; no formal content changed.
blocker: Structural tests cannot separate A4 from the personal source, since A4 is a structural duplicate by definition. The discriminating question is the coherence of A4's payment: can a plurality of modes ranked in several respects in a simple nature be mind-independent and non-composing at once, or does it need a unifying principle that only being understood supplies (#1879 with #1892)? Further: a non-counterpossible analogue of error and correction at a necessary source; explanatory use of the modes requiring them to be for the source.

current_assessment.scope: Owner-approved round-3 tests of the gap between imitability exemplars (A4) and apprehension: counterfactual guidance by outweighed reasons and self-application, applied identically to the personal source
current_assessment.assessment: No change at d1fb6414. Both owner-approved tests, in their strongest encoded forms (guidance with the outweighed reason raised alone; self-application to the second-order standard), fail to separate A4 from the personal source; because A4 is defined as a structural duplicate, that parity follows from round 2's definitions and is not further evidence. Guidance separates good-tracking favouring from respect-blind and fixed favouring (respectBlindNotGuided, fixedNotGuided) and a one-respect tracker is never guided (singleRespectTrackerNotGuided; the D-nature's form only when its end content is one respect of a graded value). Strong self-application supports no value-dependence on the scenario-invariant standard (secondOrderStandardNotDependedOn); on the scenario-relative standard both sides can show it, a necessary source included (Lean-only scenarioRelativeStandardDependedOn); invariance holds only where value does not vary, which is not the good-general setting (invariantAlignmentNoSecondOrderDependence); parity at d1fb6414 is unaffected and follows from the structural duplicate; weak self-application reduces to the criterion at second order. Registration was argued, not tested: an overall-degree-only representation cannot register a respect between overall ties (degreeOnlyRegistersNoRespectBetweenTies), but respect-indexed rankings over one stand-in per candidate remain available to both accounts, so registration imposes the same demand on both and is not a discriminator or a price of A4. The two accounts face the same articulation demand with different proposed payments: a plurality in being understood versus a mind-independent, non-composing plurality (#1892), ranked in several respects.
current_assessment.next_test: 1. Coherence of the payment: can a plurality of modes ranked in several respects in a simple nature be mind-independent and non-composing at once, or does it need a unifying principle only being understood supplies (#1879 with #1892)? 2. A non-counterpossible analogue of error and correction at a necessary source. 3. Explanatory use of the modes beyond favouring that requires them to be for the source.
